decode_bytespan: decode an XLA FFI ByteSpan structure into a UTF-8 string
decode_scalar: decode an XLA FFI Scalar structure into a NumPy scalar value
decode_array: decode an XLA FFI Array structure into a NumPy array
decode_attrs: decode XLA FFI Attributes into a Python dictionary with nested support
create_ffi_error: create an XLA FFI error with a given error code and message string
get_stream_from_callframe: extract a CUDA stream pointer from an XLA FFI CallFrame
get_device_ordinal_from_callframe: extract the device ordinal from an XLA FFI CallFrame
dtype_from_ffi: map an XLA FFI data type enum to the corresponding Warp dtype
jax_dtype_from_ffi: map an XLA FFI data type enum to the corresponding JAX dtype constructor
create_execution_context: create an ExecutionContext from an XLA FFI CallFrame to access stage and stream
create_ffi_buffer: create an FfiBuffer wrapper from an XLA FFI Buffer with dtype, shape, and cuda array interface
build_xla_ffi_data_type_enum: build an XLA FFI data type enum mapping XLA types to JAX dtype constructors
review_xla_ffi_ctypes_structs: review the ctypes structures and enums that mirror the XLA FFI C API definitions
